name: Starts Corporation Inc.
summary: Starts Corporation Inc. engages in construction, real estate brokerage, real estate management, condominium development, publishing, hotel and leisure, elderly support and childcare, financial consulting, and retail and cultural businesses in Japan and internationally. The company provides construction, renovation, landscaping, property management, rental and sales brokerage, corporate housing management, rental housing guarantee, comprehensive building management, cleaning, elevator management, shopping center management, trust, insurance, asset management, and PFI consulting services.
